description: Mosaic II was a wide-field optical camera mounted at the prime focus of the Blanco 4-meter telescope at CTIO, employing an 8192x8192 pixel CCD mosaic array and a wide variety of broad-band and narrow-band filters.
facility_description: The Víctor M. Blanco 4-meter Telescope is operated at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) in Chile as part of NSF NOIRLab.
notes: Mosaic II prime-focus imager operated at CTIO from 1999 until DECam commissioning. Filter curves were measured at CTIO.
